story.nujobraincraft.stage.meet_brian_he: Meet Brian and Helen, the truth of royalty surfaces.

story.nujobraincraft.stage.know_truth_in: Beneath the flower sea tombs lies a tampered truth.
Darcy launches ethnic purge, demons face extinction.

story.nujobraincraft.dialogue.painter_in: Strange phenomena keep appearing across the land without pattern. We've surveyed and analyzed repeatedly but cannot find the source. After slaying the aberrant creatures, we obtained unfamiliar fragments. The Painter, sensitive to dimensions, decoded them into a cross-dimensional blueprint and built the dangerous Avatar Cross-Dimensional Portal.
To uncover the source of the anomalies, I volunteered as the sole cross-dimensional test subject, stepping alone into the unknown world.
story.nujobraincraft.dialogue.brian_meet: Brian: You actually crossed the dimensional rift to get here. It's been a long time since an outsider set foot on my domain. That earlier attack was just a test—I won't hurt you.
Helen: Outsider, this is royal territory. Do not trespass.
I come from the outside world, seeking the source of the anomalies
Player: I come from the outside world, seeking the source of the anomalies.

Brian: This world appears to be under my control, but in truth I've been trapped by rigid rules for countless years, repeating the same life day after day with no freedom at all. I've long wanted to see what lies beyond the rules, but I can never leave. You are the first person not bound by this world's shackles.
Helen: Beyond the floating island, the central city hides this world's biggest lie. Be careful if you proceed.
Player: What happened in this world?
Brian: It's a long story. Go south to the flower sea and you'll see a past that was deliberately hidden. The ruler of the central city tampered with everyone's memories.
Helen: Darcy has controlled the secular world for a long time. He won't allow anyone to know the complete truth.
Brian disperses into starlight, permanently gone. Helen remains to guard the island.
story.nujobraincraft.dialogue.helen_loop: After Brian dispersed, I am the only one left to guard the island.
If you seek the truth, head south to the flower sea ruins.
story.nujobraincraft.dialogue.villager_b: What do you think of the demons?
What kind of person is Lord Darcy?
Demons are brutal by nature,专门 luring and killing human children. They must be driven out and suppressed.
Lord Darcy maintains order. Until demons are eradicated, there will be no peace.
story.nujobraincraft.dialogue.villager_a: Perhaps we held too deep a prejudice against the demons.
This world seems stable, but I always feel an imperceptible power flowing above.
Years ago, a demon warrior who left his homeland and a human girl lived and grew old together here, redeeming each other and resting eternally side by side. This tender past was taken out of context and tampered with by the ruler, becoming an excuse to suppress demons. For a century, all records were destroyed. The world knows only the fabricated version, and hatred passed down through generations.
story.nujobraincraft.dialogue.demon_prel: Our people retain fragmented true memories, but we are too weak to overturn the lies Darcy created.
Darcy manipulated the truth to create ethnic hatred, launched purges in the name of stability, and oppressed demons with absolute power. This is the root of all conflict in this world.
story.nujobraincraft.dialogue.demon_chil: Why can't you go play in the city?
How do you want to be treated?
Why can't we go play in the city?
The flowers are so pretty, but people outside don't seem to like us.
When will we be treated kindly?
story.nujobraincraft.dialogue.demon_civi: Why do you hide in the flower sea?
How long has this misunderstanding lasted?
We've borne baseless accusations for generations, hiding in the flower sea, afraid to enter the city.
A hundred years, and the misunderstanding has never stopped.
story.nujobraincraft.dialogue.demon_warr: Where does the real sin lie?
We never provoke conflict. We only seek peaceful existence.
The real sin has never been in the flower sea.
story.nujobraincraft.dialogue.demon_elde: What is the truth of history?
Could the two races have reconciled?
History was burned. Only we remember the complete past.
The two races could have reconciled, but power deliberately divided them for a century.
story.nujobraincraft.dialogue.darcy.pre_: Ethnic conflict is the best tool for maintaining order. Only authoritarian control can sustain superficial stability. The weakness and emotion of demons only disrupt the rules.
story.nujobraincraft.dialogue.darcy.batt: Chaos must be suppressed. The weak do not deserve a voice in survival. Everything I do is for the stability of the world.
story.nujobraincraft.dialogue.darcy_defe: What I controlled was but this small world. Beyond the dimensional rift, there are deeper undercurrents. That is all the hidden truth I can tell you.
story.nujobraincraft.dialogue.demon_fare: The century-old stigma is washed clean. Our people finally have a safe haven, and the flower sea is our final refuge. We can faintly sense power converging above—the world has not truly ended. But we are inherently limited by this realm; our vision, abilities, and dimensions all have ceilings. We can never reach the higher origin. If you must continue toward the unknown, take care of yourself. We will always remember your kindness and salvation.
story.nujobraincraft.dialogue.brian_fare: I have been trapped in this void for countless ages,循环 endlessly, never free. Appearing to control the world, yet never seeing its full picture, never knowing there are realms beyond the rules. But you are different. You are a visitor from beyond, unbound by this world's rules and fate, daring to break falsehoods and brave the unknown. I can faintly sense an empty place above, where all scattered rules and power converge—the origin I can never reach. If this is the path you must take, go boldly. I truly celebrate for you.
story.nujobraincraft.dialogue.blank_comm: Everything in this world begins from blankness, and eventually returns to blankness. All obsessions, struggles, tenderness, and regrets are but fleeting lights in this void.

Do you know why snow is white? Because snow itself has no color. Countless tiny ice crystals refract and scatter light until it becomes pure white. The world I created is the same—starting from blankness, carrying all stories, truths and falsehoods, rises and falls.

Everyone in this world is trapped by rules, right and wrong, and fate, unable to escape their destined path for a lifetime. But you are different. You came from outside, unbound by these rules, not deceived by false appearances, following the truth all the way to me.

I have seen all the joys and sorrows, calculations, lies, and endings here. Everything in this world, I know clearly. But the one thing I cannot understand is the world outside, the unconstrained human heart, the courage to break through and brave the unknown like yours. I have seen all fixed fates, but never a vivid variable like you.

You have overcome so many dangers, pierced through layers of falsehood, and finally reached this most fundamental place. What is it you truly want? Do you feel you must earn my recognition for your journey to be complete, to get the final answer you seek? I control all the rules and endings of this world. But is my recognition truly what you must obtain?
(After a brief silence, the Blank gazes at you, awaiting your response...)
I want the complete truth of both worlds.
I want to bring the truth home and end the anomalies.
I don't want recognition—I want understanding and connection.

Truth... all the truth of this world has been here from the beginning. The original memories Brian carried, the forgotten truth Darcy buried, the fragmented memories of the demon tribe—they all converge here. You deserve the complete truth.

Go back... bring the truth back. You never forgot why you set out. The original purpose of crossing dimensions—to explore, find the source, bring back truth, end the anomalies. You are clearer than anyone in this world.

Understanding... connection... so what you wanted was never control or recognition. You wanted a real bridge between two worlds. This sentiment is something I have never seen in this unchanging blankness—a vivid clarity.

Having just crossed hands and hearts with you, I have completely understood who you are. You have seen the darkest of human hearts, yet did not become dark yourself. You have seen through all falsehood, yet remain pure. Unafraid of hardship, ungreedy for comfort, your heart remains clear and steadfast. This is a vividness and clarity I have never seen in this unchanging blankness.

This world was originally a closed loop with no way in or out. But your arrival left a real, undying light in this dead blankness. I grant you free passage between both worlds—bidirectional travel, free homeward passage.

Go, take the truth of this world back to your world. You belong to the vivid, colorful world outside, not in this eternal silence. May this cross-world bond between us endure. Perhaps one day you will return and fill my eternal blankness.
story.nujobraincraft.dialogue.finale.ret: You return with the complete truth of the other world, revealing the century-old injustice, the conspiracy, the rule loopholes, and the dimensional threats to the four, completely overturning their preconceptions. A phase of adventure closes.
story.nujobraincraft.dialogue.finale.bon: A bond spanning years concludes: Bone Fish, shedding its phantom form, appears in the night sky over the coast, reuniting with Nujo Native, recreating the dreamscape seascape, completing self-reconciliation and mutual healing.
story.nujobraincraft.dialogue.finale.for: The deeper dimensional conspiracy remains unresolved. The Source Void's Blank waits alone. The beings of the Brain World remain trapped in the loop of fate. Season 2 expansion reserved.
